title: Remove the redundant test/features/dashboard/.gitkeep placeholder
why: The file exists solely to keep an otherwise-empty directory tracked in git, but test/features/dashboard/ has had non-empty domain/ and presentation/ subdirectories (dozens of tracked test files) for a long time — git already tracks the tree via that real content, so the .gitkeep is inert clutter a new contributor has to notice and mentally discard.
acceptance_criteria: file removed; test discovery/CI stays green with no dependency on the placeholder
